rounds.title: Checkbox baseline
rounds.note: The SDK checkbox (et-checkbox) in flow, first drawing, drawn by the mock from @ethlete/components/design/checkbox with the real markup and CSS: et-checkbox alone and inside et-choice-field (label, et-description, hint, error, required marker), the card variant (et-selection-card), and et-checkbox-group with et-checkbox-group-select-all and et-checkbox-option, plus the color-interactive and focus-ring sheets; the brand theme, danger as the error theme. Fixtures are fictional: a match-report preferences form (Send me the match report, One email per match, no ads., hint We send it after the final whistle.; I accept the terms of use, required, error Accept the terms to continue.; card Weekly digest, A summary of every match day, each Monday.; group Notify me about with All events over Kick-off, Goals, Half-time, Full-time; horizontal group Show matches: Home, Away, Neutral ground). Framed as a page with 16px padding at 360 and 640. States: a grid of unchecked, checked and indeterminate by rest, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled and readonly (all labelled); box-only (checked, no label); support (description and hint); invalid and invalid-focus-visible; card-rest, card-checked, card-hover, card-focus-visible, card-checked-focus-visible; group-unchecked, group-partial (2 of 4, select-all mixed), group-checked, group-option-hover, group-option-pressed (force hover and active), group-option-focus-visible, group-select-all-focus-visible and group-horizontal. Numbers (light / dark), from shot pixels at scale 2 at 360, brand mint, a: unchecked box border (surface border) vs page 1.26 / 1.73, the same for the option and select-all boxes and the card edge; hover border 10.37 / 13.07; checked and indeterminate fill (primary) vs page 1.33 / 13.50, check and dash on it 15.82; checked hover fill (-hover) 1.37 / 13.06, 1.03 from rest; active fill 2.24 / 8.01; focus-visible fill (-focus) 1.37 / 13.06; focus ring on a checked or indeterminate box (primary -focus) 1.37 / 13.06, on an unchecked box (surface text colour) 17.93 / 17.18; card checked edge and card ring (primary) 1.33 / 13.50; option and select-all ring 1.37 / 13.06; invalid box border (danger) 4.83 / 3.71, its focus ring (danger -focus) 6.47 / 2.77; disabled checked fill 2.20 / 1.70, disabled unchecked border 1.12 / 1.27 (exempt under 1.4.11). Decided rules that arise: Q88 (the checked and indeterminate ring, the invalid ring, the card ring, the option and select-all rings in ink; the unchecked ring is the surface text colour, not a primary ring, so it stays), Q99a (the card checked and focus edge and the focused option, select-all and card box borders take light-dark(ink, primary); the checked and indeterminate box, the checked option box and the checked or mixed select-all box are mint fills, so they take a 1px inset ink edge, an outline at -1px as in the table round; on the option and select-all the focus ring owns the outline, so the edge leaves while it shows) and Q101 (a filled checked or indeterminate box hovers to -active). The ink edge on a mint fill arises, so Q102 arises: b draws the edges in both schemes, c keeps dark as today (light-dark(ink, transparent)). The error border is the danger theme, not mint, and passes 3:1, so it is kept. Findings for later: (1) lib bug: .et-checkbox-box, .et-checkbox-option-box and .et-checkbox-group-select-all-box are content-box, so --et-checkbox-size 20px draws a 24px box (48 sheet px at scale 2) in an app without a global border-box reset; the choice field indents the hint and error by gap + size (28px), so they start 4px left of the label column (label at 48, hint at 44 CSS px from the frame edge). (2) WCAG 1.4.11: the unchecked box border is 1.26 / 1.73 vs page, under 3:1; it is the only edge of an unchecked box (the same question as the switch off track, switch r1, open). Not drawn. (3) The required marker takes the error theme primary: 3.71:1 in dark, under 4.5:1; exempted here. (4) Focus-visible lightens the checked fill to -focus (1.37 vs page, light), so a focused checked box reads paler than at rest; the ink ring carries the state in b and c. (5) Readonly draws exactly like rest (no affordance by design); a checked readonly box cannot be told from an editable one. (6) Mock: et-description now has its own stylesheet (description.component.css, f5722a1f5), so the mock's inline copy can import it instead. Later rounds, left out here: the sizes sm and lg, the card with the control at start, a coloured (non-brand) checkbox, the group's bulk-edit mixed state (dashed option boxes, a primary mark that Q99a would reach), a disabled or readonly group, a group with error and the group card variant, long labels that wrap, RTL and the check and uncheck animation.

a.note: Today, the lib as is. On light the mint marks sit near 1.3: the checked and indeterminate fill 1.33 vs page, its hover 1.37 (1.03 from rest), the checked ring 1.37, the card checked edge and ring 1.33, the option and select-all rings 1.37; dark 13.50 / 13.06 / 13.06 / 13.50 / 13.06. The invalid ring is 2.77 in dark. The unchecked border is 1.26 / 1.73 (finding 2), and the hint sits 4px left of the label (lib bug, finding 1).

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88, Q99a and Q101, decided rules only, edges in both schemes. Q99a: the checked and indeterminate box, the checked option box and the checked or mixed select-all box keep the mint with a 1px inset ink edge (outline at -1px), light 5.48 vs page and 4.13 vs the fill; the card checked and focus edge and the focused option, select-all and card box borders take light-dark(ink, primary), light 5.48 vs page (was 1.33). Q88: the checked ring in ink, light 7.68 vs page (was 1.37), 5.60 vs the -focus fill; card, option and select-all rings 5.48 to 7.68 (was 1.33 / 1.37); the invalid ring takes the danger ink, 8.31 / 9.45 (was 6.47 / 2.77). Q101: the checked hover fill takes -active, 1.69 from rest (was 1.03), check on it 9.38, its ink edge 3.43 vs the fill, 7.68 vs page. In dark the ink is the mint: the edge merges with the rest fill (1.00) and shows as a 1.69 mint line on the -active hover fill. Unchecked ring, error border, unchecked border and text unchanged. Picked because these are the only decided rules that apply, they lift every light mark past 3:1, and they match the table, match and scheduler b picks. Q102 open; if dark should stay as today, take c.

c.note: b with every inset ink edge in light-dark(ink, transparent) (Q102): light equals b (edge 5.48 vs page, 4.13 vs fill; hover edge 3.43 vs the -active fill; rings 5.48 to 7.68). Dark: no edge on the checked, indeterminate, option or select-all fills, as today, so the -active hover fill shows no mint line; rings stay ink (Q88), hover takes -active (Q101). It keys on color-scheme, not on the surface; my reading of rule a, not a decided rule (Q102).
